patch_description:
Add two new Ising entangler gates to expand qubit connectivity and improve worst-group margin separation:
- ZZ gate on qubits [0,3] with param "zz_03" 
- XX gate on qubits [2,7] with param "xx_27"

These additions increase from 6 to 8 unique two-qubit gates, targeting previously unconnected qubit pairs (0-3 and 2-7). Historical data shows this expansion from Gen 31→36 tightened worst-group margins. The new gates are inserted in the entangler block after existing gates, maintaining the circuit structure while improving expressivity for hard-to-separate samples. Total distinct params increases from 11 to 13, but parameter efficiency gain from improved worst-group margin should outweigh the small overhead.
